pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

3. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .

4. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   D. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   D. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   C. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   D. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   B. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The New Testament Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Galilean Ministry 2.4 Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians 3.0 Church in Actio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

3. A — Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. D — Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The New Testament Books; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Galilean Ministry 2.4 Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians 3.0 Church in Actio; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
